linkedin_content_opportunities.hook: 500 college students showing up to a fest entrance will break any online ticketing app.
linkedin_content_opportunities.tech_insight: Walk-in cash issuance with offline HMAC QR generation. Network drops shouldn't stop ticket validation.

linkedin_content_opportunities.hook: We published 54 campus event guides in a single sprint to dominate local Google & Perplexity search.
linkedin_content_opportunities.tech_insight: Dynamic schema markup, JSON-LD event registries, and programmatic content generation for student discovery.

linkedin_content_opportunities.title: Redesigning the Campus Ambassador Experience for Zero Friction
linkedin_content_opportunities.hook: If your campus ambassador form looks like a corporate HR portal, college students won't sign up.
linkedin_content_opportunities.tech_insight: Editorial layout, instant preview cards, eliminating CSS chunk preload lag for 2G campus Wi-Fi.

linkedin_content_opportunities.title: Cross-Campus Teaming: The Real Bottleneck in Student Hackathons
linkedin_content_opportunities.hook: The best developer at Raghu doesn't know the best UI designer at GITAM. We're fixing that across 19 colleges.
linkedin_content_opportunities.tech_insight: City-level Guilds (Code, Design, Product) and Circles (Social) connecting 19 Vizag engineering campuses.
